_about: The pilot's preset grids (brief 09 F.1; Q16). Defaults, not decisions: edit before running scripts/run_pilot.py. Half-lives: null = infinity (equal weights, the reference arm). The experts' and the gate's half-lives are given as calendar years of the stress regime and turned into regime-days as stress_share * years * trading_days_per_year (theory notes section 5): with stress_share 0.3, 10 and 5 years are 756 and 378 regime-days.
_experiment_about: Experiment fields fixed for every pilot run (anything not listed keeps run_experiment.Experiment's default). Only the decided design is set here: the frozen Hamilton gate (Q19), the residual base with corrections (Q7), the 2000-2024 panel. K, widths and depth (Q18, Q8/Q17) stay at their current defaults.
